light.best.quote: This genus of plants prefers partial shade or bright, indirect sunlight.

light.directSun.quote: They are tolerant of the morning sun, but the hot afternoon sun should be avoided.

watering.growing.quote: The soil recommended should be moist, well-drained
Root rot can occur from overwatering or poor drainage.

tips.ja: 急な温度変化で葉が落ちる。
